newsitem.title: UK: UK has no comment yet on Hyundai investment report.
newsitem.headline: UK has no comment yet on Hyundai investment report.

text.p: The British government declined to comment on press reports that South Korean company Hyundai Group is to build two plants in Scotland and create 700 jobs.
"There is no official word on any of this yet," a spokesman for the Scottish Office said.
Britain's Press Association said Hyundai would produce semiconductors at new plants at Dunfermline in the Fife region.
Gordon Brown, the economics spokesman for the opposition Labour party, hailed the reported deal.
Brown, who is member of parliament for Dunfermline East, told BBC's Nine O'Clock News: "This is a hugely welcome investment."

An investment by Hyundai would come shortly after South Korea's LG Group in July signed a 1.7 billion stg agreement to make semiconductors and electronic goods in Wales -- which made it the biggest single investment by a foreign company in Britain to date.
